flag_note: InterFax HP-1 is the canonical historical Harmonic Percolator product. Historical sources describe multiple early versions, but the archive should retain those as specimen or production-state flags until dated examples can be separated reliably.

Effects Database and ToneHome independently identify Ed Giese / InterFax Electronics in Milwaukee as the maker of the 1970s Harmonic Percolator. Later Chuck Collins/Theremaniacs products are successor reproductions/rights history, not additional original builders.

Sandro Marchetti's interview ties MET of Carlo Baldoni to the earlier technical/electromechanical work that fed into Logan, G.I.S. and later EF-EL activity. Keep this as historical infrastructure and lineage context, not a confirmed separate dirt-pedal factory.
Sources disagree or remain imprecise on exact start/end dates; retain the 1970s production corridor while avoiding an invented precise launch year.
